schema_note: One row per link the owner supplied. intended_asin, official_listing_url, confirmation_date and confirmation_source are set ONLY from an official Amazon listing that the owner has confirmed as the intended product. observed_* fields are what a fetch of the supplied link returned on observed_on; they are kept in separate fields and are never copied into the intended fields. A 9-character short code is not an ASIN, so no intended ASIN is inferred from it.
tracking_id_status: Selected by the account holder. Not applied to any outbound link yet. The Associates one-link test (Manage Tracking IDs and a tracking report, S6) has not been run, because it needs the account holder's Associates Central login. Applying the ID to all links is gated on that test.
